Le bloqueur de pubs et de traqueurs des: The ad and tracker blocker for the sites opened in NeoDex: every uBlock Origin list (ads, tracking, annoyances, cookie banners) and EasyList, through Ghostery's engine, refreshed weekly. YouTube has its own rules, taken from uBlock Origin every 12 hours (videos without ads, "Skip" clicked for you). The ADBLOCK button in the address bar turns it off on a site; its right click, "an ad got through?", blocks what you tick. Before NeoDex 3.2 it was built into NeoDex: your excluded sites are kept.
